questions.q:
In a certain code language, 'BK + EZ' is coded as '737', and 'IC + PD' is coded as '257'. How will 'LG + MF' be coded in that language?

एक निश्चित कोड भाषा में, 'BK + EZ' को '737' के रूप में कोडित किया गया है, और 'IC + PD' को '257' के रूप में कोडित किया गया है। उस भाषा में 'LG + MF' को कैसे कोडित किया जाएगा?
questions.s:
'BK + EZ' is coded as '737'.

B = 2 and K = 11. So, BK is written as 211. E = 5 and Z = 26. So, EZ is written as 526.

211+526= 737.

'IC + PD' is coded as '257'.

I = 9 and C= 3. So, IC is written as 93. P = 16 and D = 4. So, PD is written as 164.

93+164= 257.

Similarly,

L = 12 and G = 7. So, LG is written as 127. M = 13 and F = 6. So, MF is written as 136.

127+136= 263.
